The forecast has no deadline and no qualifying conclusive event.
limitations: The distinction between a temporary pause and stopping development is an interpretation of the surrounding argument.

The public disclosures do not establish every internal training decision through the cutoff.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: If AI labs stop training, their models will eventually drift into obscurity.

statement.excerpt: if they stop training, the models will eventually drift into obscurity.

our_interpretation: They refers to OpenAI and Anthropic in the surrounding passage.
Stopping training means ceasing continuing model development, rather than briefly suspending selected runs or finishing training one model.
Obscurity means losing meaningful practical use and deployment, rather than merely losing first place on a benchmark.
criteria.support_condition: A relevant lab stops continuing model training, and subsequent usage and deployment records show its models losing meaningful practical relevance.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After a qualifying cessation, decisive evidence establishes that the models will retain meaningful relevance despite the cessation. Continued use over a finite interval alone cannot disprove eventually.
